title: Chit's Optimum Life
description: Mod pack that optimizes and adds other quality of life features. The mod's present are heavily inspired by Fabulously Optimized, but with additional and some removed mods.
body:
# Chit's Optimum Life

**Chit's Optimum Life** is a high-performance, Fabric-based modpack designed to provide the perfect balance between "Vanilla+" quality of life and cutting-edge optimization. Heavily inspired by the foundation of **Fabulously Optimized**, this pack streamlines your Minecraft experience by using well known optimization mods, and adding additional features for better gameplay.

Whether you are looking for smoother frame rates, better visual fidelity, or small tweaks that make daily gameplay less tedious, this pack has you covered.

## Key Features

* **Extreme Optimization:** Powered by **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **ImmediatelyFast** to ensure maximum FPS and stability even on lower-end hardware.
* **Voxy Integration:** Features **Voxy**, a modern LOD (Level of Detail) renderer that allows you to see massive distances without the performance hit of traditional chunk loading.
* **Visual Enhancements:** Full support for shaders via **Iris**, plus built-in features for connected textures (**Continuity**), **BetterGrassify**, and **LambDynamicLights**.
* **Quality of Life:** Includes essential tools like **AppleSkin** for hunger details, **Zoomify** for better viewing, **MiniHUD** for technical info, and **Simple Voice Chat** for multiplayer immersion.
* **Modern Utility:** Features **Bobby** for extended render distances, **FastQuit** to jump between worlds instantly, and **ClientSort** to keep your inventory tidy.
* **Better Feedback:** Improved UI elements like **Better F3**, **Detail Armor Bar**, and **Better Statistics Screen** make information clear and accessible.

## Performance & Stability

This pack uses the latest performance mods to ensure your game runs as smoothly as possible:
* **Dynamic FPS:** Reduces resource usage when the game is minimized.
* **Entity Culling:** Stops rendering what you can't see to boost frames.
* **FastQuit:** Allows you to return to the main menu while the world saves in the background.
